response.original_title: The gods of the nations are demons
response.overview: Gods, goddesses, and mythological creatures from all corners of the world are not merely imaginary characters, figures of fantasy, or creations of the mind of ancient people. They are demons, devils, creatures of darkness, bearing many names and taking many forms. Unseen and unnoticed by most people, they are still present upon the face of the earth. They seek to afflict and torment, devour lives, imprison souls, and wage war against mankind. Take heed that your heart be not deceived. “The gods of the nations are demons,” the Scriptures instruct, and “I don’t want you to have fellowship with demons.
response.tagline: Take heed that your heart be not deceived
response.title: The gods of the nations are demons
